PATRICIA WILLARD: Lawrence Brown felt that sharing a taping session with Barney Bigard would be fruitful. On July 5th, we set up such asituation at the home of Bea Price, who is the widow of drummer Jesse Price. Every time I pushed the record button, Lawrence froze. Off the tape, however, Lawrence and Barney were converesing freely. So I pushed the button without warning in the midst of a reminiscence about some of Juan Tizol's practical jokes, which are described in detail in Barney's interview. The next words…
( IN THE FOLLOWING TRANSCRIPTION, THE DESIGNATIONS "BROWN" and "BIGARD" ARE REVERSED THROUGHOUT. J.R.T. ) UNTIL P. 13
